exercises.title: Analyze a trace
exercises.task: Write Analyze: from the lines of a trace, compute each span's total time, the deepest nesting, and the three slowest spans, or the first error with its line number. The spec is in the comments of the file. Run prints the report for a sample trace and for broken ones.
hints: Read each line with strings.Fields and strconv.Atoi; anything that is not time start|end name is an error.
A stack of open spans (name and start time) gives both the nesting depth and the check that each end closes the innermost open span.
Add durations in a map[string]int; for the slowest, copy the names into a slice and sort by duration, then name. Keep at most 3.
